description: A download link, valid an hour, for one file: a picture or video in the artist's Library (media_asset_id from list_media), or the picture or video on a post (post_id), such as a video Audora made. For a video made without the song (sound none), it also gives the caption and the steps to post it in the app with the song's official sound.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

post_id.description: A post whose picture or video to download (get_campaign or promo_this_week).

name: get_media_file
title: Download a Library file
